title: fix(service-analytics): declare the multi-value filter refusal on /analytics/query and the native arm of /analytics/sql
body:
Fixes #36264
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the published skills already teach `$contains` for membership on a multi-value field (skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md); this diff rewrites a pending narrowing note and adds pins, nothing an author writes changes

## 维护者速读
- 用户无感:只改即将发布的升级说明,让调用通用分析查询和 SQL 预览接口的集成方在升级前看到这项拒收。
- 属于分析报表的数据正确性收口,替调用分析接口的集成方补上漏写的破坏性变更说明。
- 出错只会让发布说明的措辞不准,不改任何运行行为;可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes
- `.changeset/36168-dataset-json-column-refusal.md` (unreleased, consumed by the open Version Packages PR): the summary line, the `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` reason and the BREAKING paragraph now name `POST /api/v1/analytics/query`, the native-SQL arm of `POST /api/v1/analytics/sql`, and the `timeDimensions[].dateRange` window (a `$gte` / `$lte` pair) beside the dataset door. The ADR-0087 marker's prose names the same doors. No production code changes.
- **DELIBERATE CORRECTION** (`check-empty-changeset` stays red by design): the pending note `.changeset/36168-dataset-json-column-refusal.md` was false by omission — it declared the refusal for the dataset door only, while `query()` and `generateSql()` share the same strategy context (`callCtx`, carrying `declaredValueShape`) and so refuse the same filter. Corrected sentences:
  - summary: "the dataset query door, `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` and the native arm of `POST /api/v1/analytics/sql` refuse `=`, `$in` and every other scalar comparison or text operator on a multi-value or JSON field with the data door's `400 INVALID_FILTER`, instead of answering a wrong count"
  - `Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the dataset query door, `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` and the native SQL arm of `POST /api/v1/analytics/sql` refuse a scalar comparison on a multi-value or JSON field, in a `where` or a `timeDimensions[].dateRange` window, that they answered `200``
  - BREAKING: "... and for a client of `POST /api/v1/analytics/query` or of `POST /api/v1/analytics/sql` answered by the native SQL strategy whose `where` applies — or whose `timeDimensions[].dateRange` window (a `$gte` / `$lte` pair) applies — an operator of `JSON_COLUMN_INCOMPATIBLE_OPERATORS` ..."
- One new top-level `describe` in the existing harness `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-json-column-refusal-36168.test.ts`: `AnalyticsService.query` and `.generateSql` on the `postgres` dialect, `{ tags: { $in: ['a'] } }` on a `select` declared `multiple: true` → `INVALID_FILTER` / 400; control `$contains` resolves; and `query` with a `dateRange` on a `tags` time member → `INVALID_FILTER` / 400.

## Tests
- Read first: (1) the BREAKING paragraph of the changeset, it is the text that ships; (2) the new `describe` block at the end of the test file.
- Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/dataset-json-column-refusal-36168.test.ts -t 36264` — expect 5 passed.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-off, not kept)</summary>

Mutation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `analytics-service.ts`, in `query()` only: `const ctx = await this.callCtx(...)` became `const ctx = { ...(await this.callCtx(...)), declaredValueShape: undefined }` (anchor x1 -> x0, blob bf7a2df1c981 -> edaab3fae524). Result: `query: $in ...` and `query: ... dateRange ...` red, `generateSql: $in ...` green (its context untouched) — 2 failed | 1 passed. Restored: blob == HEAD (bf7a2df1c981), `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../analytics-service.js` from `src/`, so no `dist/` rebuild was involved.
</details>

## Patch round (contract review 7100067069, items S1 · N1 · N2 · N4)
- S1: the unknown-dialect sentence now says the decline covers the `where`, dataset `filter`, measure `filter` and read scope, and that a `timeDimensions[].dateRange` window on such a field is refused `400 INVALID_FILTER` on every datasource the native strategy compiles for (`jsonConstructOnUnknownDialectIn` reads no `timeDimensions`).
- N1: the BREAKING paragraph attaches the window clause to all three doors, the dataset door's `selection.timeDimensions[]` included.
- N4: "a field declared `multiple: true`" became "a multi-value or JSON field", naming the multi-capable types the code judges (`select`, `radio`, `lookup`, `user`, `file`, `image`).
- N2: the `dateRange` pin runs on `query` and `generateSql`, each with a scalar `datetime` time column control that resolves.
- The declaration line now carries the `(narrowing)` arm, because the diff rewrites a narrowing note.

## Acceptance notes
- The dateRange position was measured, not assumed: on a member whose declared shape is JSON-stored (`tags`), `query()` answers `Operator "$gte" on field "seen" WAS NOT APPLIED ...` (400 INVALID_FILTER). A `datetime` declared `multiple: true` is not JSON-stored (`isMultiValueField` does not count `datetime` as multi-capable) and is answered 200, so the changeset says "on a multi-value or JSON field" only.
- Placement: the pin lives as a new top-level `describe` in the existing #36168 harness file rather than a new file, per the AGENTS.md test-placement rule (a new pin for a component that already has a shared harness file goes in that file).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exits 1 against the Version Packages PR, which shares the changeset file; expected, that PR regenerates from the changeset and is not touched here.
